```{r}
islands <- readRDS("/media/volume/fhardie-ntl-data/gadm/gadm41_USA_1_pk.rds") |>
  unwrap() |> st_as_sf() |> subset(NAME_1 == "Hawaii") |> st_cast("POLYGON")
cent <- st_coordinates(st_centroid(st_geometry(islands)))

roi_state <- islands[cent[, 1] > -158.8, ]  # HECO islands
roi_oahu  <- islands[cent[, 1] > -158.4 & cent[, 1] < -157.6 &
                     cent[, 2] > 21.2   & cent[, 2] < 21.8, ]
```

```{r}
oahu_boundary <- counties(state = 'HI', cb = TRUE) %>%   
  filter(COUNTYFP == '003')

hawaii_places <- places(state = 'HI', cb = TRUE)  
oahu_places <- st_filter(hawaii_places, oahu_boundary)
```

```{r}
vol     <- "/media/volume/fhardie-ntl-data"
ntl_dir <- file.path(vol, "ntl_baseline")

NOISE_FLOOR <- 3

all_dates <- list(
  baseline = seq.Date(from = ymd("2025-05-01"), to = ymd("2025-08-03"), by = "day"),
  storm1   = seq.Date(from = ymd("2026-03-10"), to = ymd("2026-03-16"), by = "day"),
  gap      = ymd("2026-03-18"),
  storm2   = seq.Date(from = ymd("2026-03-19"), to = ymd("2026-03-24"), by = "day")
)
```

```{r}
##roi for cropping
roi_sf <- st_sf(geometry = st_union(st_geometry(roi_oahu)))
oahu   <- vect(roi_sf)
nrow(roi_sf)
```

```{r}
##find tiles and read dates
tifs <- list.files(ntl_dir, pattern = "\\.tif$", full.names = TRUE)

get_date <- function(f) {
  m <- regmatches(basename(f), regexpr("[0-9]{4}_[0-9]{2}_[0-9]{2}", basename(f)))
  as.Date(gsub("_", "-", m))
}
tif_dates <- do.call(c, lapply(tifs, get_date))

stopifnot(length(tifs) > 0, !anyNA(tif_dates))
length(tifs)
```

```{r}
##crop to oahu and build list
rs <- lapply(tifs, function(f) crop(rast(f), oahu))

r_list <- lapply(names(all_dates), function(p) {
  idx <- which(tif_dates %in% all_dates[[p]])
  if (length(idx) == 0) return(NULL)
  idx <- idx[order(tif_dates[idx])]
  r <- rast(rs[idx])
  names(r) <- as.character(tif_dates[idx])
  r
})
names(r_list) <- names(all_dates)
r_list <- r_list[!sapply(r_list, is.null)]

data.frame(
  period    = names(all_dates),
  requested = sapply(all_dates, length),
  retrieved = sapply(names(all_dates), function(p) if (p %in% names(r_list)) nlyr(r_list[[p]]) else 0)
)
```

```{r}
##baseline mean and noise floor
ntl <- r_list$baseline

base_mean <- mean(ntl, na.rm = TRUE) |>
  crop(oahu) |>
  mask(oahu)

cutoffs <- c(0.5, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5)
shares  <- sapply(cutoffs, function(f) global(base_mean >= f, "mean", na.rm = TRUE)[[1]])
setNames(round(shares, 3), cutoffs)

hist(values(base_mean), breaks = 100, main = "Baseline mean radiance, Oahu")
```

```{r}
oahu_places <- st_transform(oahu_places, 4326)

keep_mask <- ifel(base_mean >= NOISE_FLOOR, 1, NA)

r_raw <- lapply(r_list, function(r) mask(crop(r, oahu), keep_mask))
r_log <- lapply(r_raw, log1p)

places_outline <- as.polygons(keep_mask, dissolve = TRUE) |> st_as_sf()

global(keep_mask, "notNA")
sapply(r_log, nlyr)
```

```{r}
##period mean, baseline, zscores
mean_log <- lapply(r_log, mean, na.rm = TRUE)

base_sd <- stdev(r_log$baseline, na.rm = TRUE)
base_sd <- ifel(base_sd > 0, base_sd, NA)

zscore <- function(x) (x - mean_log$baseline) / base_sd

z_storm1 <- zscore(mean_log$storm1)
z_storm2 <- zscore(mean_log$storm2)
z_gap    <- zscore(mean_log$gap)

z_storm1_nightly <- zscore(r_log$storm1)
z_storm2_nightly <- zscore(r_log$storm2)
```

```{r}
z_all <- list(storm1 = z_storm1, storm2 = z_storm2, gap = z_gap)
do.call(rbind, lapply(z_all, global, fun = c("min", "mean", "max"), na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r}
##building map function 
map_metric <- function(r, title, subtitle = NULL, caption = NULL, fill = NULL,
                       ncol = NULL, lim = NULL) {

  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = roi_oahu, fill = "white", color = "gray45", linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_spatraster(data = r) +
    geom_sf(data = places_outline, fill = NA, color = "gray45", linewidth = 0.4) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "black", mid = "white", high = "gold1",
                         midpoint = 0, na.value = "transparent",
                         limits = lim, oob = scales::squish) +
    labs(title = title, subtitle = subtitle, caption = caption, fill = fill) +
    coord_sf() +
    theme_void() +
    theme(plot.title    = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 6)),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 12)),
          plot.caption  = element_text(size = 9, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(t = 12)),
          strip.text    = element_text(size = 12),
          plot.margin   = margin(20, 20, 20, 20))

  if (!is.null(ncol)) p <- p + facet_wrap(~lyr, ncol = ncol)
  p
}
```

```{r}
##storm 1 average 
map_metric(z_storm1,
           title    = "Nighttime Light Z-Scores: First Kona Low",
           subtitle = "Average of storm nights, Mar 13-16, 2026, vs. baseline of May 1 - Aug 3, 2025\nSatellite imagery taken at ~1:30 AM local time.",
           fill     = "Z-Score")
```

```{r}
regions <- list(
  "Leeward"     = c("Nanakuli", "Maili", "Waianae", "Makaha", "Makaha Valley"),
  "Ewa"         = c("Ewa Villages", "Ewa Beach", "Ewa Gentry", "East Kapolei", "Kapolei", "Makakilo",
                    "Ko Olina", "Kalaeloa", "Ocean Pointe", "West Loch Estate", "Iroquois Point"),
  "Central"     = c("Mililani Town", "Mililani Mauka", "Waipio Acres", "Waipio", "Wahiawa", "Whitmore Village",
                    "Schofield Barracks", "Wheeler AFB", "Helemano", "Royal Kunia", "Waikele", "Waipahu"),
  "Honolulu"    = c("Urban Honolulu", "East Honolulu",
                    "Pearl City", "Aiea", "Waimalu", "Halawa", "Hickam Housing"),
  "Windward"    = c("Kailua", "Kaneohe", "Kaneohe Base", "Kahaluu", "Heeia", "Ahuimanu", "Maunawili",
                    "Waimanalo", "Waimanalo Beach", "Waiahole-Waikane"),
  "North Shore" = c("Haleiwa", "Waialua", "Mokuleia", "Pupukea", "Kawela Bay", "Kahuku",
                    "Laie", "Hauula", "Punaluu", "Kaaawa")
)

region_lookup <- stack(regions)
oahu_places$region <- as.character(region_lookup$ind[match(oahu_places$NAME, region_lookup$values)])

v_places  <- vect(oahu_places)
regions_v <- aggregate(v_places[!is.na(v_places$region), ], by = "region")

table(oahu_places$region, useNA = "ifany")
```

```{r}
z_both <- c(z_storm1, z_storm2)
names(z_both) <- c("First Kona Low", "Second Kona Low")

z_region <- terra::extract(z_both, regions_v, fun = mean, na.rm = TRUE) |>
  mutate(region = regions_v$region, .before = 1) |>
  select(-ID) |>
  pivot_longer(-region, names_to = "storm", values_to = "z")

ggplot(z_region, aes(x = z, y = reorder(region, z), fill = storm)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "gray30") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("First Kona Low" = "black", "Second Kona Low" = "gold1")) +
  labs(title = "Which Storm Hit Which Region Harder?",
       subtitle = "Mean Nighttime Light Z-Score by Region",
       x = "Mean Z-Score", y = NULL, fill = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title    = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(t = 6, b = 6)),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 12)),
        legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r}
z_pixels <- terra::extract(z_both, v_places) |>
  mutate(place  = oahu_places$NAME[ID],
         region = oahu_places$region[ID]) |>
  pivot_longer(c("First Kona Low", "Second Kona Low"), names_to = "storm", values_to = "z") |>
  filter(!is.na(z), !is.na(region))

z_pixels |>
  group_by(region, storm) |>
  summarise(n_pixels    = n(),
            mean_z      = mean(z),
            median_z    = median(z),
            pct_below_2 = 100 * mean(z < -2),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(region, storm)
```
